notes.title: Update 4.4
notes.content:
The biggest and most anticipated update for Hex Commander: Fantasy Heroes is now live! A complete Dwarven campaign, a new “Heroes Royale” multiplayer mode and a new “Tesla” premium unit are adding more fun and challenges to the current content.
The final chapter takes you to the Dwarven kingdom, where you’ll have to face new enemies that you haven’t encountered before. With three new playable heroes and their unique abilities, you’ll jump into the middle of epic battles to stop the evil forces from spreading across the world.
In the dwarven campaign you’ll not only fight alongside new units, you'll also meet new enemies that weren’t present in the previous chapters.

notes.title: Update 4.2
notes.content:
The final chapter of Greenskins campaign is now available! We hope that you’ve liked the new heroes and missions – as always we are looking forward to your feedback. Conclusion of the story of Vulpis, Ildus and Guarg has also some nice surprise for the players who played human campaign... But we don’t want to spoil too much. We started the development of the Dwarves campaign, it will be available later this year, but we don’t want to give any specific date yet.

notes.title: Update 4.1
notes.content: Update 4.1 is available. In the next ten missions you'll follow the adventures of Vulpis, Ildus and Guarg. In the next chapter of the Greenskins campaign they will unveil the truth about the flood and they will face the new enemy... We also improved and balanced the multiplayer and fix some minor bugs. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.content:
The long awaited first chapter in the Greenskins campaign is now available! In the Greenskins campaign we are introducing 3 playable heroes!

◼️ Ildus – a powerful red dragon, who can set fire to enemies that can even spread onto a nearby enemy causing more damage within enemy ranks.
◼️ Vulpis – a goblin master thief, who can create an illusion of himself, and teleport to it to outwit the enemies. He throws knives from great distances which makes him even more deadly.
◼️ Guarg – he is the leader of the orcs, he can strike all surrounding enemies with one mighty blow of his deadly axes.

In the new base you can also unlock new units such as – Orc Shamans, not only can they magically throw stones and smash them above enemies heads, but they also can protect allied units by casting shields over them.
We also added one new premium unit, the most lovable and fun fellow in the entire kingdom. Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome Clube, the Troll. He is not very witty, but he loves his club (and likes to eat soup). This savage beast has a unique set of skills as well.

Of course more Greenskins missions will be added in upcoming updates which will be more frequent. First step in creating the race is always the most resourceful part of the development. Thanks for your constant support and reminding us that you want MORE, that really drives us! 💚

notes.title: Update 3.8
notes.content: Final chapter of Arcaena and Sylvius adventures is now available. Update 3.8 concludes the Elf Campaign, and we can officially reveal that first chapter of Greenskins campaign will be available in June! New heroes, new missions, new units – stay tuned for more information, meanwhile download the latest update and fight Vivric for the last time (or not...?).

notes.title: Update 3.6
notes.content:
Update 3.6 is now online. It features three new missions in the elf campaign – Arcanea and Sylvius's quest to find the Jeger’s Blade continues. Escalation of the conflict with humans will put our heroes in harm’s way. But we are sure that with your commanding skills you’ll lead them into victory.
This update also introduces a new feature – post processing effects that will make the environment more atmospheric and add cinematic looks to the graphics. Here is an important part – effect is disabled by default. We want to check with you first if you like it. We also want to point out, that we won’t force it at any point. Even if we make it enabled by default, there will always be an option to switch it off. Just let us know what you think.
To play with those new options just select menu Settings, you’ll find them in the Graphics section.

notes.title: Update 3.4: new campaign and multiplayer mode
notes.content:
We are really proud to introduce you to update 3.4! It’s the biggest one we’ve done to date for Hex Commander: Fantasy Heroes and we are just warming up! We wanted to address the two most common requests from our dear community – a new race with a campaign and multiplayer mode.

In the new standalone elf campaign you’ll plunge into the story of Arcaena, leader of the Elven archers, and help her bring the much-desired peace to the Elven lands of Fairavrig. During your adventures you’ll meet a second hero as well. There are twelve missions as an introduction and the next chapters of the campaign will be available periodically.

Multiplayer was also a highly requested feature.  We are starting with  two  modes (Battle and Capture the Flag) with four maps for each type. We will be looking for your feedback, as we previously mentioned. We have long-term plans to develop and update both multiplayer and singleplayer modes. 

Elf campaign also features a new base, with new buildings and units you are able to recruit. We are also introducing a new premium unit  –  Redwood Elder Hunter who is a deadly archer, trained for long range shots.

notes.title: Update 3.3
notes.content:
Update 3.3 is available. It contains 2 small but useful improvements:

 You can reset specific mission progress from the map and start over without starting with "Continue battle" option. It can help in some cases of game freezes.
 You can select lower difficulty of mission. That way you can earn extra money required for further progress.
